newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian foreign reserves hit $18.9 billion.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian foreign reserves hit $18.9 billion.

text.p: Egypt's foreign reserves rose to $18.9 billion at end-November, equivalent to more than 16 months of imports at 1995/6 levels, from $18.5 billion at end-June, official sources said on Wednesday.
The increase came mainly from central bank purchases of foreign exchange which has flowed into the country in the form of portfolio or direct investments, bankers said.

Minister of state for economic monitoring Youssef Boutros-Ghali told Reuters he estimated portfolio investment in Egypt this year at between $600 million and $700 million and direct investment at about $2 billion.
